thread:
lia: Quick proposal to tighten postmortem follow-ups and make action tracking less flaky. Key bits: tiny action template, 10-day ack SLA, biweekly remediation sync (30m), IC rotation change to 2-week windows with 3-day handoff, and a monthly trends review to spot recurring signatures. feedback?

ben: I like small templates. what fields are you thinking?

lia: draft here:```
- Action: one-line description
- Owner: @handle (or unassigned)
- State: proposed / accepted / blocked / validating / done
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Ack: owner ack ts
- Prod-verify: checklist link or done ts
```

arun: state machine is solid. 10-day ack feels long; why not 72h?

lia: 72h is ideal but reality is people are on call, PTO, etc. 10 days is a pragmatic default that reduces noise. we can encourage 72h for P0/P1.

marta: biweekly sync is OK but make it 30m sharp. agenda: 1) new actions (5m) 2) blocked owners (10m) 3) ETA slippage (10m) 4) close verification (5m). also rotate two leads per meeting.

ben: rotation suggestion: 2-week ICs with a 3-day overlap sounds reasonable. the overlap should include a doc handoff and a 30m pair session.

arun: escalation flow suggestion: if any action slips >7 days past ETA escalate to #pm-escalate and tag manager. auto-create escalation message from tracker.

lia: good. automation ideas: Slack modal to create actions (prepopulates owner, incident, and priority) + a tiny tracker dashboard in the console showing open count, blocked, and avg time-to-ack. call it 'Remediation Heatmap'.

marta: Love the heatmap idea. very useful for trend triage. on triage: monthly "recurring signatures" meeting where we group similar incidents and assign 1-sprint spikes.

ben: For pilot, propose 2-week run across 4 postmortems: infra, serving, embeddings, and runtime. success metrics: ack rate >80% within 10 days, >50% items closed or in-validation after 2 weeks, and fewer repeated signatures next month.

lia: I'll spin up the pilot checklist and tracker sheet. minimal workflow: create action -> owner ack -> ETA -> track in sheet -> auto-escalate if late -> verify in prod -> close.

oncall-bot: Reminder: please ensure incident 1969950002 action items are listed in tracker by EOD.

arun: low-effort MVP for create modal: payload example:
```json
{
  "incident": "1969950002",
  "action": "Rotate model cache more frequently",
  "owner": "@arun",
  "priority": "P1"
}
```

marta: who will own scheduling the biweekly sync and rotation calendar? ops team or SRE?

ben: ops can own the calendar; ownership of items remains with engineers/PMs. ops just makes sure invites go out.

lia: ok i'll publish the one-pager + template and set the pilot start next Tuesday. will ping here with links.

ben: great. volunteer list for pilot owners: infra - marta, serving - ben, embeddings - arun, runtime - lia.

marta: confirmed for infra.

arun: confirmed for embeddings.

lia: thanks all. quick ask: if you see an action you can't take, reassign within 48h so it doesn't stall.

oncall-bot: Pilot kickoff event created: 1970600000. Reminder set for 24h before.

ben: sounds good. drop the doc and i'll add invites for the biweekly syncs. :thumbsup:
